record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, normalize every nonpadding item embedding to a fixed L2 norm sqrt(2*64/(itemnum+2+64)), matching the expected initial Xavier row norm. Use this effective tied table consistently for context lookup, masked-item cross-entropy and candidate scoring; keep padding zero and the exclusive mask as a separate ID. Removing item-norm variation may improve angular discrimination without increasing width, whose earlier expansion regressed. Preserve positional embeddings, topology, history, loss definition and optimizer; update the predictor writer consistently.
